question: After 138 US state minimum wage rises, jobs paying below each new minimum vanished. What happened to the total number of low-wage jobs?
options: It fell by about as many
answer: It stayed roughly the same. Cengiz, Dube, Lindner and Zipperer counted jobs by wage band against states without rises: over five years, the jobs lost below each new minimum were matched by extra jobs at or just above it. Most of the missing jobs had not gone; their pay had crossed the line.
move: Before counting what vanished below a line, count what appeared above it.
ask: Before I count what vanished, have I counted what appeared?
trap: Counting the vanished low-paid jobs as losses without looking just above.
reference: Cengiz, Dube, Lindner & Zipperer, The Effect of Minimum Wages on Low-Wage Jobs, Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2019
